## Review checklist

- [ ] The change follows CONTRIBUTING.md and preserves file-write guarantees.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; any checks not run are listed above.
- [ ] Marker parser or import merge changes include unit tests, or neither is affected.
- [ ] Affected documentation and its Russian translation are updated, or no update is needed.
- [ ] User-visible changes have one Unreleased changelog entry, or behavior is unchanged.
- [ ] Shipped code/resource changes increment appBuild once, or neither is affected.
- [ ] Assistant guide/connector versions reflect installed-content changes, or neither is affected.
- [ ] Added dependencies/assets have license attribution, or neither is added.
- [ ] The diff and attachments contain no credentials or private user data.
